target_customer: AI agent builders and fast-growing startups in healthcare, logistics and hospitality that must act in web portals without APIs
problem: AI agents are forced to click through UIs built for humans. Zatanna records a workflow once, reverse engineers the network calls and serves a stable read and write API.
business_model: Usage or subscription API infrastructure (pricing not stated on sources opened)
product_category: Agent infrastructure, reverse-engineered APIs for software without APIs

founders.name: Tarun Vedula
founders.background_notes: One profile lists him as COO.

founders.name: Rithvik Vanga
founders.background_notes: Named in the YC launch post; one search snippet of the YC listing calls him CEO while the fetched page names Tarun as CEO.

competitors.name: Integuru
competitors.what: Open source agent that reverse engineers a site's internal APIs and generates integration code (YC W24)
competitors.traction_then: about 4,500 GitHub stars per a directory listing

competitors.name: Kampala
competitors.what: YC W26 company that reverse engineers apps into APIs, same batch

technical_complexity.rationale: Automatically deriving stable APIs from network traffic, handling auth, sessions, retries and portal changes, and evading anti-bot systems is hard engineering for a two to three person team.

defensibility.rationale: Open source tools and a same-batch competitor target the same idea; terms of service risk applies to reverse engineered endpoints.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy found as of the search.

market_need_then: Agents depend on UI clicking in portals such as ERP, freight carrier and insurance systems that lack APIs; the company positions speed (milliseconds, not seconds) against browser agents.

branding.name_origin: One secondary site says it is named for Zatanna Zatara, the DC Comics sorceress who casts spells by speaking backwards, tied to reversing software; not confirmed by the company.

identity.visual_style: Editorial law-meets-AI look with classical engravings
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and direct, for example UIs are for humans, not agents

branding.brand_signature: UIs are for humans, not agents headline
branding.community_and_virality: No community evidence found; the product also launched a product line called Kampala per one launch listing, so the naming may be split.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive comic book name and a sharp tagline, but name shares a spelling burden with the DC character and there is no evidence of brand pull yet.

outcome_analysis: Zatanna was in YC Winter 2026 and launched at Demo Day in March 2026, so there is no outcome yet. It has a technical team with anti-bot experience but works in a niche already addressed by an open source project and a same-batch peer, so execution speed and reliability will decide whether it becomes infrastructure that agents depend on.
notes: VCBacked lists $500K pre-seed with Y Combinator as investor and also describes a healthcare assistant, so the profile is unreliable; matches YC standard deal; not recorded as a round. Founder roles conflict between sources. Competitor Integuru source is undated. Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs.
